task.title: Calm an upset customer whose new mixer grinder stopped working
task.brief: You work at the counter of an electronics and home store. Mr. Imran comes in, upset. The mixer grinder he bought 10 days ago stopped working this morning, and guests are coming home tonight. He has the bill. The store gives a 7-day replacement, and after that the brand gives a 1-year warranty with service in 2 to 3 days. Speak to him for 60 to 90 seconds, as you would at the counter. A good answer: greets him and stays calm; says sorry and listens; asks to see the bill and the product; explains clearly and honestly what the store and the warranty can do (no false promises); offers something helpful for tonight if possible (for example, booking service quickly or checking with the manager); and ends with a clear next step and time. You can speak in English, Telugu or Hindi.
key_points: Greets and stays calm; says sorry for the trouble
Listens and asks for the bill and the product
Explains the 7-day replacement is over but the 1-year warranty covers it
Is honest: no promise the store cannot keep
Offers practical help: book service fast, check with manager, quick testing
Ends with a clear next step and time frame

rubric.label: Greeting and structure
rubric.guide: 0 = no greeting, no order; 3 = greets but jumps around; 5 = greets, listens, checks bill, explains, gives a next step in order

rubric.label: Empathy and calm
rubric.guide: 0 = argues or blames the customer; 3 = polite but cold; 5 = says sorry, shows he understands the guests problem, stays calm

rubric.label: Correct policy and solution
rubric.guide: 0 = wrong or false promise; 3 = partly right; 5 = correctly explains replacement period over, warranty covers it, offers a real way forward

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = hard to follow; 3 = understandable with some confusion; 5 = simple, clear words and a clear final step with time
